name: WorkbookQuery
description: An object that represents a query that was created by Power Query. Introduced in Office 2016.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The name of the query. Read/write String.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: The Power Query M formula for the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: The description of the query. Read/write String.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes this query and its underlying connection and removes it from the Queries collection.

parameters.name: DeleteConnection
parameters.description: True To delete the both the query and its underlying connection . The default is False.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes this query and its underlying connection.
